root_cause.text: `crypto/authencesn.c` failed to validate that the AEAD associated data length was at least 8 bytes, so `crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt()`/encrypt() could operate on an ESP/ESN AAD shorter than the expected header and advance scatterlist pointers past valid entries, causing `scatterwalk_map_and_copy()` to dereference a NULL pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (assoclen < 8) return -EINVAL;` to both `crypto_authenc_esn_encrypt()` and `crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt()`, and the CVE description states that too-short AAD lets `crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt()` “advance past the end of the destination scatterlist” and trigger a NULL pointer dereference in `scatterwalk_map_and_copy()`.
